title: Forensics: Artifact Recovery - Temporary File Analysis
problem: Temporary file analysis misses deleted artifacts. Need improved temp file recovery and timeline reconstruction.
evidence: Deleted temp files lost on volume cleanup
No NTFS recovery attempt for temp artifacts
cause: Tool only reads existing temp files. No MFT-based recovery or deleted cluster analysis for temp directory.

recommended_actions.action: Implement MFT-based recovery for deleted temp files using NTFS filesystem analysis

lesson_learned: MFT-based recovery is complex and error-prone. Recovery success depends heavily on filesystem state and deletion timing. High effort implementation yielded only 60% of expected benefit. Consider vendor tools instead.
